question: What is StreamKar?
answer: StreamKar is India's top live streaming mobile application. It allows users to broadcast their lives, showcase their talents (singing, dancing, cooking, comedy, gaming), watch live streams, video chat with friends, and make new friends globally. It's a vibrant social platform where you can connect with people from around the world in real time.

question: How do I download the StreamKar app?
answer:
You can download StreamKar from multiple platforms:
• **iOS**: Search 'StreamKar' on the Apple App Store or visit https://itunes.apple.com/app/streamkar/id1182923162
• **Android (Play Store)**: Search 'StreamKar' on Google Play Store
• **Android (APK)**: Download directly from https://apk.sktv.live/share/download/StreamKar.apk
You can also visit streamkar.com and scan the QR code to download.

question: How do I create an account on StreamKar?
answer:
To create an account on StreamKar:
1. Download and open the StreamKar app
2. You can sign up using your phone number, Facebook account, or Google account
3. Create your profile by adding a display name and profile picture
4. Once registered, you can start exploring live streams and interacting with the community immediately.

question: How do I start streaming or go live on StreamKar?
answer:
To start a live broadcast on StreamKar:
1. Open the StreamKar app
2. Click the camera icon on the main page
3. You may need to complete a verification process first (identity verification)
4. Once verified, set your stream title and category
5. Tap 'Go Live' to start broadcasting
6. You can use beauty filters, stickers, and other tools to enhance your stream
Note: You must be at least 18 years old to go live.

question: What is the minimum age to use StreamKar?
answer: You must be at least 18 years old to go live and broadcast on the StreamKar platform. This age requirement is strictly enforced as part of StreamKar's commitment to user safety and content moderation.

question: What are Beans in StreamKar?
answer: Beans are the virtual reward currency that streamers earn on StreamKar. When viewers send you virtual gifts, those gifts are converted into Beans in your in-app wallet. Beans can be accumulated and converted into real money once you reach the minimum withdrawal threshold. They represent your earnings as a broadcaster on the platform.

question: What are Diamonds in StreamKar?
answer: Diamonds are the virtual currency that viewers purchase with real money on StreamKar. Viewers use Diamonds to buy and send virtual gifts to their favorite streamers during live broadcasts. Diamonds cannot be cashed out by streamers directly — when a viewer sends a gift purchased with Diamonds, the streamer receives the equivalent value in Beans, which can then be converted to real money.

question: What are Gifts in StreamKar?
answer: Gifts are animated virtual items that viewers can send to streamers during live broadcasts to show their appreciation and support. Each gift has a different Diamond value — from small, affordable gifts to premium, expensive ones. When a streamer receives gifts, they are converted into Beans (the streamer's earning currency). Gifts create exciting visual effects during the stream, making the experience more interactive and fun.

question: How do I earn money on StreamKar?
answer:
There are several ways to earn money on StreamKar:
1. **Receive Gifts**: Viewers send you virtual gifts during your live streams, which convert into Beans
2. **Become an Official Host**: Join an agency to get a base salary by meeting streaming targets (minimum hours and effective streaming days per month)
3. **Build Your Fanbase**: More followers = more gift revenue
4. **PK Matches**: Compete with other streamers to attract gifts from viewers
5. **Cash Out**: Convert your accumulated Beans into real money through the app's withdrawal system
Consistent streaming and engaging content are key to maximizing your earnings.

question: How do I cash out or withdraw my earnings from StreamKar?
answer:
To withdraw your earnings from StreamKar:
1. Go to your profile/wallet section in the app
2. Check your Beans balance
3. Once you reach the minimum withdrawal threshold, you can request a payout
4. Earnings are typically transferred to your registered bank account or payment method
5. If you're part of an agency, payouts may be managed through your agency
Make sure your account verification and banking details are complete before requesting withdrawals.

question: What are VIP, SVIP, and VVIP memberships on StreamKar?
answer:
StreamKar offers three tiers of premium membership:
• **VIP**: Basic premium tier with a special VIP badge, enhanced entrance effects, and additional interaction features
• **SVIP**: Mid-tier premium with more exclusive badges, stronger entrance effects, and greater visibility in streams
• **VVIP**: The highest tier with the most exclusive badges, premium entrance effects, maximum visibility, priority in chat rooms, and the most prestigious status on the platform
All tiers provide enhanced personalization, unique badges, and improved interaction capabilities with your favorite streamers.

question: What is a PK Match on StreamKar?
answer:
PK (Player Kill) Match is an exciting competitive feature on StreamKar where two streamers go head-to-head in a live battle. During a PK:
• Two streamers compete simultaneously in a split-screen format
• Viewers support their favorite streamer by sending gifts
• The streamer who receives more gifts/points within the time limit wins the PK
• The loser typically has to perform a fun punishment
PK Matches are one of the most entertaining and engaging features on the platform, driving viewer interaction and excitement.

question: What is SK SQUAD on StreamKar?
answer:
SK SQUAD is StreamKar's group/community feature that allows users to create or join chat groups with friends and like-minded people. In an SK SQUAD, members can:
• Chat with each other in a group setting
• Share updates and coordinate activities
• Build a loyal community around shared interests
• Support each other during live streams
It's a great way to build your social circle and strengthen your connection with fans and fellow streamers.

question: What is the Multi-Guest feature on StreamKar?
answer:
The Multi-Guest feature on StreamKar allows group video chats with up to six people simultaneously. This feature enables:
• Multiple users to join a single live stream as co-hosts
• Interactive group discussions and collaborations
• Fun group activities and performances
• Enhanced viewer engagement with multiple personalities on screen
It's perfect for collaborative content creation, group discussions, and creating more dynamic and entertaining streams.

question: How do I send gifts on StreamKar?
answer:
To send gifts on StreamKar:
1. Open a live stream you want to support
2. Tap the gift icon at the bottom of the stream screen
3. Browse the available gifts (each has a different Diamond cost)
4. Select the gift you want to send
5. Tap 'Send' to deliver the gift to the streamer
6. If you don't have enough Diamonds, you'll need to purchase them first through the in-app store
Gifts create animated visual effects on the stream and directly support the streamer's earnings.

question: How do I buy Diamonds on StreamKar?
answer:
To purchase Diamonds on StreamKar:
1. Open the StreamKar app
2. Go to your wallet or the recharge/top-up section
3. Select the Diamond package you want to buy (various amounts at different price points)
4. Choose your payment method (credit/debit card, UPI, net banking, or other available options)
5. Complete the payment
6. Diamonds will be credited to your account immediately
Diamonds are used to purchase and send virtual gifts to your favorite streamers.

question: What is the Admin feature on StreamKar?
answer:
The Admin feature on StreamKar allows streamers to appoint trusted users as moderators for their chat room. Admins can:
• Monitor the chat during live streams
• Block or mute offensive or inappropriate users
• Help maintain a positive and safe environment in the stream
• Remove spam or harmful content
Streamers can assign Admin privileges to reliable fans or friends to help manage their growing community effectively.

question: How does StreamKar ensure safety and content moderation?
answer:
StreamKar takes safety very seriously with multiple measures:
• **24/7 Content Monitoring**: The platform employs round-the-clock content monitoring teams
• **Strict Filtering**: Automated systems filter inappropriate content
• **Admin Feature**: Streamers can appoint trusted moderators
• **Report System**: Users can report violations directly in the app
• **Community Guidelines**: Clear rules that all users must follow
• **Age Verification**: 18+ requirement for live streaming
• **Account Verification**: Identity verification for streamers
StreamKar is committed to creating a safe digital platform for all users and the broadcasting community.

question: How do I report inappropriate content on StreamKar?
answer:
You can report inappropriate content on StreamKar in two ways:
1. **In-App Reporting**: Click the three dots on the user's profile or in the live stream, then select 'Report' and describe the violation
2. **Email**: Send a screenshot of the violation to complaints@streamkar.com with the subject line 'Inappropriate Content'
StreamKar's moderation team reviews all reports and takes action against violators, including warnings, temporary bans, or permanent account termination.

question: What are beauty filters and stickers on StreamKar?
answer:

• **Stickers**: Fun animated overlays, face stickers, and themed decorations

These tools help streamers look their best and create more visually appealing and entertaining content during live broadcasts.

question: What is the Audio Room Party feature on StreamKar?
answer:
Audio Room Party is a feature on StreamKar that allows users to host or join audio-only chat rooms. In an Audio Room:
• Multiple users can participate in voice conversations
• No video is required — perfect for those who prefer audio-only interaction
• Great for discussions, music sessions, storytelling, and casual hangouts
• Users can interact through voice and text simultaneously
It provides a more relaxed, radio-style experience compared to video streaming.

question: How do I become an official host or streamer on StreamKar?
answer:
To become an official host on StreamKar:
1. **Meet Age Requirement**: You must be at least 18 years old
2. **Join an Agency**: Apply through or get recruited by an official StreamKar agency
3. **Provide Identification**: Submit valid ID documents (such as PAN card or Aadhaar card in India)
4. **Complete Verification**: Pass the platform's identity verification process
5. **Meet Streaming Targets**: Maintain minimum streaming hours and effective streaming days per month to qualify for base salary
Official hosts receive a base salary (upon meeting targets) plus earnings from gifts received during streams.

question: What is the Spotlight feature on StreamKar?
answer:

question: Is StreamKar free to use?
answer:
Yes, StreamKar is completely free to download and use! You can:
• Create an account for free
• Watch live streams for free
• Chat with streamers and other users for free
• Go live and broadcast for free (after verification)
Optional paid features include purchasing Diamonds to send gifts to streamers and subscribing to VIP/SVIP/VVIP memberships for premium perks. But the core streaming and viewing experience is entirely free.

question: How does the StreamKar algorithm work?
answer:
While the exact algorithm is proprietary, StreamKar generally promotes streams based on:
• **Viewer Count**: Streams with more active viewers tend to rank higher
• **Gift Activity**: Streams receiving more gifts get higher visibility
• **Engagement**: Active chat and viewer interaction boost rankings
• **Consistency**: Regular streamers are favored by the platform
• **Spotlight Usage**: Streams using the Spotlight feature get promoted
• **Recency**: Newly started streams get an initial visibility boost
The best way to grow on the platform is to create engaging content consistently and build an active community.

question: What happens if I violate StreamKar's rules?
answer:
If you violate StreamKar's rules or community guidelines, the following actions may be taken:
• **Warning**: First-time minor violations may result in a warning notification
• **Temporary Suspension**: Repeated or moderate violations can lead to a temporary ban (hours to days)
• **Permanent Ban**: Serious violations (explicit content, harassment, illegal activity) can result in permanent account termination
• **Content Removal**: Violating content will be removed from the platform
• **Earnings Forfeiture**: In severe cases, accumulated earnings may be withheld
StreamKar employs 24-hour content monitoring and strict filtering to maintain platform safety.

question: Can I use StreamKar on my computer?
answer: StreamKar is primarily a mobile application designed for iOS and Android devices. However, you can access some features through the StreamKar website at streamkar.com. For the full streaming and viewing experience with all features (filters, gifts, PK matches, etc.), using the mobile app is recommended. Some users also use Android emulators on their computers to run the mobile app on desktop.

question: How do I register or sign up for a new account on StreamKar?
answer:
To register or sign up for a new StreamKar account:
1. Download the StreamKar app from the App Store (iOS) or Google Play Store (Android)
2. Open the app and tap 'Sign Up' or 'Register'
3. You can sign up using your phone number, Facebook account, or Google account
4. Enter the required details (name, phone number, etc.)
5. Verify your phone number via OTP (One-Time Password)
6. Set up your profile with a display name and profile picture
7. Start exploring live streams or go live yourself!
Make sure you are at least 18 years old to create a broadcasting account.

question: Can I delete my StreamKar account?
answer:
Yes, you can delete your StreamKar account. To do so:
1. Open the StreamKar app
2. Go to your Profile settings
3. Look for 'Account Settings' or 'Privacy Settings'
4. Find the 'Delete Account' or 'Deactivate Account' option
5. Follow the on-screen instructions to confirm deletion
Please note that deleting your account is permanent — all your data, followers, earnings history, and content will be removed. If you have pending earnings, make sure to withdraw them before deleting your account. You can also contact StreamKar support for assistance with account deletion.

question: Is there a desktop or PC version of StreamKar available?
answer:
StreamKar is primarily a mobile application available for iOS and Android. There is no official desktop or PC version. However, you have some options:
• **Website**: Visit streamkar.com to access limited features via your browser
• **Android Emulators**: Use emulators like BlueStacks or NoxPlayer on your PC to run the StreamKar Android app
• **Screen Mirroring**: Mirror your phone screen to your computer for a larger display
For the best experience with all features (beauty filters, stickers, gifts, PK matches), using the mobile app is recommended.

question: How do I set up or edit my profile on StreamKar?
answer:
To set up or edit your StreamKar profile:
1. Open the app and go to your profile page
2. Tap the 'Edit Profile' button
3. You can update the following:
   • **Profile Picture**: Upload a clear photo of yourself
   • **Display Name**: Choose a unique and memorable username
   • **Bio**: Write a short description about yourself
   • **Gender & Age**: Set your basic info
   • **Location**: Add your city/region
4. Save your changes
A complete and attractive profile helps you gain more followers and viewers when streaming.

question: How do I report a user or inappropriate content on StreamKar?
answer:
To report a user or inappropriate content on StreamKar:
1. Go to the user's profile or the live stream you want to report
2. Tap the three-dot menu (⋮) or the report icon
3. Select 'Report' from the options
4. Choose the reason for reporting (harassment, explicit content, spam, etc.)
5. Add any additional details if needed
6. Submit the report
StreamKar's moderation team reviews all reports and takes appropriate action, which may include warnings, temporary suspensions, or permanent bans depending on the severity of the violation.
